name: honcho-plugins
description: Persistent memory for coding-agent CLIs via Honcho — unofficial community plugins (Kimi Code CLI, Devin CLI)

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:kimi && bun run build:devin
scripts.build:kimi: bun build packages/kimi-honcho/src/hook.ts --target=node --outfile=packages/kimi-honcho/dist/hook.mjs && bun build packages/kimi-honcho/src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=packages/kimi-honcho/dist/cli.mjs
scripts.build:devin: bun build packages/devin-honcho/src/hook.ts --target=node --outfile=packages/devin-honcho/dist/hook.mjs && bun build packages/devin-honcho/src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=packages/devin-honcho/dist/cli.mjs
